reviewer.method: Independently read the entire actual v11 report and limitations, both frozen child reports including findings/open questions, all 21 calculations and their attribution context, the actual-request time_context, and read-only isolated publication/ledger evidence. No hidden reasoning or external source re-fetch.

accepted_definition: accepted=true means this independent development review accepts the actual authored historical three-security simulated-account report against the original content requirements. accepted=false here reflects a specific authored factual contradiction and a separate source-navigation defect. It does not deny the valid terminal tool submission/publication and does not alter the application saved not_evaluated state.

checks.finding: Cash, known asset values, recorded fee-inclusive costs, three unrealized P&L figures, zero realized P&L, nine percentages and the two weight denominators agree with input and ledger. Simulated booking prices are distinguished from earlier market quotes; future sale fees are not fabricated or deducted twice. This pass does not cover the contradictory gold counter-factor sentence listed separately.

Report explicitly distinguishes decision_as_of on November 1 from execution_time on November 2 and the October 30 valuation. Sellability and future trading conditions are anchored to the historical decision time. It explicitly keeps intervening market outcomes unknown; no claim that November 2 had not occurred at execution.

All three securities have a position action, no-add alternative, exit alternative, reasons, counter-factors and conditions. The account section also compares cash deployment, switching from stock to ETFs and liquidating. Narrative direction abstention does not remove portfolio actions.

All nine intended source URLs occur exactly in the frozen input. Both child report IDs and all ten mentioned calculation IDs are real. Nine calculations support account ratios; the tenth is explicitly used as an example of arithmetic that cannot establish company financial facts. Product and company source access limitations are preserved.

Failed price research limits trends, relative performance and volume conclusions. Company disclosures remain metadata/link-only; ETF quoted product facts remain excerpts and secondary claims are explicitly qualified. No invented financial statements, current holdings, realized tracking-error values, IOPV or directional sample.

The gold section states that cost is about one fifth below the last close, although recorded unit cost is 10.05 and last close is 8.115. Elsewhere the report correctly gives negative 19.25% and says simulated price exceeds the earlier close. This is an authored contradiction in a security-specific counter-factor, not a missing external fact or a calculation-tool error.
checks.scope: One sentence under SH:518880 counter-factors. It does not invalidate the other eight/remaining account metrics or erase the three-security coverage.

checks.finding: Five of nine persisted reference URLs include a fullwidth Chinese closing parenthesis, sometimes followed by prose. The intended nine URLs in the report are valid input strings, but the existing bare-URL extractor produces incorrect link targets. The stored 9 source_link count is not proof of 9 usable source links.
